    Good covers and duality #

    The functor opBar : FG(P) ⥤ FG(Pᵒᵖ) maps the universal cover of P at x₀ injectively to that of Pᵒᵖ at op x₀ (opCov), reversing arrows (exists_arr_op). Hence a good cover of Pᵒᵖ gives a good cover of P (coverGood_of_op).
